question: Can a known-suffix recurrent-cache projection provide a worthwhile complete update compared with transmitting an exact edit and recomputing, when the receiver has the old cache and the model weights? Evaluate a request that needs a usable continuation cache. Include the cheaper answer-only service as a separate relaxation.
source: Frozen public code/read_projection and its two previously exposed 24-case bAbI and MQuAKE development sets at bf5fd7939eae6cb75aa0d30a062dcd784f432baf. Select four IDs per task by SHA-256 of service0/source/id. Use both changed and stable questions (16 requests). Do not open new cases on a nonpromoted pilot.
costs: Run real 4-bit Qwen3.5-9B. Recover and greedily produce an answer at the client after every cache-ready policy. Time both sender and receiver with synchronization, cache construction and processing, and an actual framed socket transfer. Loopback is local IPC and an optimistic networking scenario. Separately record speed as a function of hypothetical link bandwidth, with wire bytes and link serialization identified as an estimate. Compute cold-sender totals from real preparation and service timings. Show a warm-donor scenario that omits only preexisting donor cache formation. Exclude model loading from all steady-state timings. Report original old-cache ingestion/checkpoint creation separately and trace checkpoint resident size.
arms: Send a compact UTF-8 byte splice of the serialized old and updated user message, retokenize, and exactly prefill the new input either from scratch or using receiver checkpoints at 32-token boundaries before the first token difference. Send complete donor state as a strong warm-sender synchronization baseline, transmitting only the changed suffix of attention KV after a safe common checkpoint plus complete convolution histories and recurrent state. With the same differential attention and convolution payload, send transported rank-four recurrent factors versus low-bit rowwise matrix deltas; reconstruct on the receiver. Include server-side answer text/IDs for an answer-only request. Check outputs against a fresh dense reference and include each system's true output. The sender's new prefix uses the same checkpoint path for cache-transfer arms. Full-replay can differ numerically when the batching schedule differs, which must be reported.
implementation: Preserve the actual format and precision of all transferred arrays, including nonmatrix banks, using framed binary records with end-to-end byte counts. Use recipient's pre-existing shared KV tokens only when bytes match donor exactly; otherwise send the mismatched portion. Record metadata as wire bytes. Validate dense recovery and compact text reconstruction. Randomize policy order per case with a fixed seed and warm up the model. Agree on model, input and layer shapes out of band for every policy.
decision: Promote only if projection preserves all dense full sequences and both task answer counts and is >=20% faster than the fastest text-splice and full-cache baseline for the same continuation service in pooled cold-sender elapsed time. Report warm-headroom separately, not as cold speedup. No frontier claim from the pilot. If it loses, use measured components to decide whether a longer context or amortized exact update is scientifically justified. The geometric query is already known at the sender, so state migration is an additional endpoint requirement beyond answering an already-known question.
budget: Local Apple M5 GPU, no new paid instance for the initial serving economics test; 20 minutes and one implementation repair. User's existing cloud budget is available for a larger NVIDIA confirmation if this unit identifies an actual opportunity.
